"And his mother said, "I didn't suppose that you, my child,",
"would have doubts about me." And the lion said, "I'm not",
"doubting you, mother, but I want to bring the truth to",
"light." And his mother said, "I'm afraid that if I were to do",
"this, I might appear unscrupulous."",
The first investigation of Ichnelates.
"When the lion had heard this from his mother, he sum-",
"moned all his subjects and sent for Ichnelates as well. When",
"Ichnelates saw that the lion was dejected, he said to those",
"nearby, "Why do I see that the lion is so gloomy and so de-",
"jected?" And the lion's mother replied and said, "The only",
"reason he's dejected is for allowing you to continue among",
"the living until now after you persuaded him through trick-",
"ery and cunning to kill the poor bull." Ichnelates said, "I",
"see that anyone who strives for good must be ready to ac-",
"cept misfortune rather than recognition for their good",
"deeds, and I think this is why ascetics have said farewell to",
"human society and have sought the desert. Since I am well-",
"disposed toward the king, I reported to him about the bull",
"and ruined the latter's plot. So, if you investigate carefully",
"what I reported to him, you will find that my report was",
"completely true: for the fire that is present in flint and",
